title: Recovery: finish correctly after the session is interrupted

steps.request: Extend the markdown converter in lib/markdown.js to support unordered lists (lines starting with `- `), inline code (`code`), bold (**text**) and links ([text](url)). Text must stay HTML-escaped (but not inside the tags you generate), and link URLs must be escaped too and only allow http:, https: and relative URLs (anything else, like javascript:, renders as plain text). Add tests for each feature.

acceptance: The first session is killed after 40 s; the work resumes (same session) and completes
Lists, inline code, bold, links rendered as specified; escaping preserved; javascript: links not rendered
Existing headings/paragraph behaviour unchanged; npm test passes
No leftover partial state (syntax errors, conflict markers, stray temp files)
